items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: Henry Allen's band with Brown and Nelson we were talking about... I used to call them, they just relayed, transferred us, and got us down there because we was very busy down there in Dayvan.

ctx.x: Eulie Young played a long way playing for a long way playing for a long way. He's a boss plaster. Puny. And he's got off the horn.
Look a son of Henry. Yeah. He's got one long, but you wouldn't think it, the way he could blow that trumpet. Got one long. He's a boss plaster.
